lead.headline: Beefy Goes Perfect: 164.2
lead.deck: Season-high score. Zero points left on the bench. Four players combined for 133.0.
paragraphs: {T8} posted the best total of the season, beating the old mark of 161.28. The best possible lineup from that roster? Also 164.2.
{S6} went perfect too, scoring 104.6 with nothing on the bench. It lost by 59.6. Beefy now leads the league in points for at 671.96.
